caption: The drawing features a four-legged wooden table with a rectangular top and straight, vertically oriented legs. The table is colored in various shades of brown, with visible wood grain patterns suggesting a polished wood surface. The table's top appears flat, and the legs are evenly spaced at the corners. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, inset illustration from a top angle, depicting a detailed view of the table's corner and showing the construction of the table's apron and how the legs are connected. This detailed inset includes a depiction of a drawer partially pulled out, revealing an internal support structure. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or cream color and is framed with a simple rectangular border.
title: Drop Leaf Table
